_comment: P10 (F3) — maps a QC repair finding's CLASS to the repair LEVER that addresses its CAUSE. A templating finding whose cause is a dealt slot (a shared scene frame, a stamped venue, a reused name) routes to a `redeal:*` lever that bumps the blueprint's slot salt and regenerates the owning section artifact; a prose-local finding (a bar-axis miss, a semantic-alignment nit) routes to `surgical` (edit the chapter, then sync back into its artifacts); a templated-SOURCE finding routes to `escalate:research` (halt for re-research — you cannot un-template a book by editing chapters). The `redeal:*` levers correspond 1:1 to the four blueprint slot salts (exampleFrames / venues / quizShapes / names). Order below is the family → lever contract from the sweep families (see src/qc/sweepSpec.ts).
